payload.title: Low-dimensional nonlinear coefficient learning
payload.statement: Split-local prediction of a small number of nonlinear correction coefficients or control points can recover materially more of E010 candidate coverage than flat family/candidate ranking, while remaining memory-safe and falling back exactly to E006 when confidence is weak.
payload.evidence_for: E011 independently reproduces spline4_ridge_equal_s075 at 12.5507562957 RMSE versus E006 at 14.9331407872. It wins all five maps and all 25 repeated cells, improves every spatial/typewell holdout and registered special slice, and passes all 21 scientific controls.
payload.evidence_against: The prepared Kaggle inference notebook has not yet been run, so its saved competition outputs have not been reviewed.
payload.next_test: T020: run the prepared E011 notebook, retrieve submission.csv, e011-run-receipt.json, and e011-well-predictions.json, and verify row coverage, IDs/order, finite predictions, and readable outputs.
